channel_scope.reason: The pre-factor locator family still false-positives on known total3/4 negative controls and on multi-hit-root total2 surfaces.

pre_factor_gate.name: single_prefactor_hit_root
conditions: full materialized FFE surface has at least one selected root pair
selected public leaves expose exactly one distinct known hit root before factorization
pre_factor_gate.derived_from: two fresh preregistered positives on 152-159 and 160-167 plus earlier 112-151 diagnostic; broad pre-factor gates fail when multi-hit-root surfaces are admitted, while the single-hit-root subgate has remained preserving, false-positive-free, and below rho on retained total2 surfaces

primary_root_policy.name: prefactor_unique_leaf_hit_root_first_target_hash
primary_root_policy.policy_identity_selection_rule: selected before 168-175 from the 152-159 and 160-167 handoffs: fresh single-hit-root total2 tests were 13/13 combined preserving, zero false positives, 13/13 scan-below-rho, and 13/13 direct-below-rho
algorithm: read pre_factor_selected_hit_roots and pre_factor_selected_hit_root_pairs from the preregistered gate manifest
require exactly one distinct pre-factor selected hit root for promotion
rank Sage root-hyperplane candidates whose root is that pre-factor hit root first
fall back to target_root_hash among non-hit-root candidates
stop at the first public-zero root hyperplane
charge all selector work plus root-scan and direct-root accounting

baseline_root_policies.name: all_prefactor_gate_prefactor_unique_leaf_hit_root_first_target_hash
baseline_root_policies.reason: broad pre-factor gate failed on 144-151 and 152-159 through multi-hit-root surfaces

baseline_root_policies.name: target_root_hash
baseline_root_policies.reason: previous static primary; preserving but too expensive on 128-135

promotion_condition: After generating the 168-175 total2 strict signature and pre-factor manifest, factor only surfaces with exactly one distinct pre-factor selected hit root and score prefactor_unique_leaf_hit_root_first_target_hash. Count as a third replicated total2 scan-positive only if all selected single-hit-root surfaces are preserving, false-positive-free, and scan-below-rho. Count as a weaker direct-root positive if all are preserving, false-positive-free, and direct-below-rho.
non_claims: This does not promote total3/4 surfaces.
This does not claim end-to-end ECDLP recovery faster than Pollard rho.
This does not claim the dropped multi-hit-root surfaces are useless; they are outside this promoted gate.
